blocks.text: Bringing your own house to Detroit Lakes?  Let Baxstar make the experience even more memorable by putting you on proven fishing spot.  All you have to do is show up!  What's more, you get the spot's coordinates for life.  The price listed below is for Detroit Lake.  We offer plow and prep services on other lakes in the area.  Prices vary based on a variety of factors.  Contact us using the form below to get a quote.
